Portfolio

Smart Meal Plan

An AI-powered meal planning app, linking multiple AI logics to generate personalized weekly meal plans based on your fridge content and preferences.

An AI & UX project at Julius-Maximilians-Universität Würzburg

My Role

  • UX/UI Design
  • Concept Development
  • AI Flow in Flowrabbit
  • Building Prototype in Figma

The Need

People are often too busy or uninspired to plan balanced meals with the ingredients they already have at home, resulting in stress, poor nutrition, and food waste. The goal was to design an app that simplifies meal planning and grocery shopping by integrating multiple AIs.

Target Group

Adults, ages 18-50

Main characteristics:
busy, cook for themselves, familiar with mobile apps

Design

AI Logic in Flowrabbit

Flowrabbit is a no-code platform that lets companies build and share custom GenAI tools and workflows by connecting existing AI services and models.

First Draft for AI Flow

  • Image AI detecting ingredients in a photo of a fridge
  • LLM generating a meal plan based on user input and the detected ingedients

Final Version AI Flow

  • Ingredient detection in multiple photos
  • Output divided into segments via JSON
  • LLM converting output into a document that can be downloaded as a PDF file
